title: MemorySmith Markdown Profile
description: The machine-readable half of the profile: every notation it declares, with its observable effect and whether it is recognised.

variant.description: The value of the variant parameter of text/markdown, per RFC 7763.

sources.description: Where the forms this profile declares were established. A source is cited per form in SPEC.md; it is not a tier the profile is built out of.

id.description: Stable identifier. Never renamed and never reused.

reader.description: Which reader decides this notation. The first two are the only readers of content an indexer has; the third is display.

syntax.description: The form, as an author would type it.

example.description: A body exercising the form, used verbatim by the conformance suite.

effect.description: What observably happens. Written for whoever writes a note, not for the code.

recognised.description: False when the point of the entry is that NOTHING happens. Those entries are as normative as the others.

spec.description: The section or sections of SPEC.md that govern it.
